description: State-port registry (RFC-048 §12.6, RFC-049 §5). Ports are bytes 0–255. MSHS-2 (MASH) reserves the top band; no SAMESTATE range may span it. Bands may overlap across coin classes (ports are per-coin namespaces), never across the MSHS boundary.

mshsBand.notes: bundleBase = 256 - (4 + k) = 230 (k=22). Header R/ROOTS_BLOB/SECRETS_BLOB/TREE_SIG at 230-233; PROOF at 234-255. The node refuses any tx with state in 230..255.

bands.notes: MSHS-2 committed-owner-v1: STATE(0)=current state preimage, STATE(1)=signed successor. Only used in committed mode (the state root is also committed into the locking script).
channel/factory control (100 SETTLEMENT, 101 SEQUENCE, 102 COMMITMENT, 103 escape)
channel program ports (COUNTER 120-122, METER 130-133, HTLC 140-144, VAULT 150-152, TREASURY 160-164, MEMBERSHIP 170-172, ASSET 180-183)
per-party share band, base 128 (POOL_SHARE_PORT_BASE / FACTORY_BALANCE_PORT_BASE); capped below the MSHS floor 230 → max 102 parties

wallet.notes: Default. MASH bundle in STATE 230-255; app state free. Used by the composite table.

committed-owner-v1.txShape: exactly 1 input, 1 output, no recovery branches; successor commits STATE(1) and preserves the amount; current+next <= 24 KiB
committed-owner-v1.notes: State root committed into the locking script. Owner-authoritative single-owner carrier (vault/treasury, RFC-051 committed facts). NOT composable with Omnia multi-party scripts and NOT compatible with P-EXIT (recovery branch forbidden). Excluded from composites.

instructionBudget.notes: MASH wallet-mode envelope = 795 + 12*(inputs-1) + 37*(outputs-1) (mshs2_modes.hpp, depth-15). A composite's MASH envelope + Omnia script ops MUST stay <= kissvmMaxInstructions; that is why the verifier is a MAST dispatch (R-MASH-5), not inlined.

mash+omnia-factory.instructionBudgetNote: MASH envelope (795) + the factory script's conservative op bound (~247) exceeds the KISSVM 1024 limit. Model B (MASH-aware factory) needs a trimmed factory script or a per-branch budget; until then MASH authorizes the factory only at the boundary (Model A), not inline. Tracked per R-MASH-5.

rules: R-MASH-1: MASH state lives only in the MSHS band (>= 230); no other package may allocate there.
R-MASH-2: Omnia variable-length bands (party shares) MUST be allocated below the MSHS floor (base 128).
R-MASH-3: No SAMESTATE range may span the MSHS band.
R-MASH-4: A composite (MASH + Omnia + MAST) transaction MUST publish a port-allocation table and pass an instruction-budget check.
R-MASH-5: Omnia scripts MUST NOT embed the full MASH verifier in the update path.
